review_scope: 65 source-classification leads plus eight specific holds from consolidated 169 candidate intake
review_method: All 73 source URLs classified by host/path and existing source notes; exactly 17 entries separately corroborated against retrieved external institutional pages. No blanket live-fetch or exact GPS certification for the others.
rules: Source URL scope ≠ approved Catholic identity ≠ accepted map point ≠ owner approval
Third-party GCatholic classification may start discovery but never replaces direct institutional physical-site corroboration
Historical non-Latin Catholic/heritage locations remain distinct from Latin Mass or present-day schedules
Adjacent distinct church buildings remain independent physical-site candidates even when under 500 metres
An official UNESCO multi-component inscription gives site identity but not an entrance point
All owner decisions remain pending; no prod mutation, no auto-import
